turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Yeh bilkul ungrateful nahi sound karta — mujhe samajh aa raha hai tum kya keh rahi ho.

Jab saas expert hai, toh ek ajeeb si feeling aati hai na — jaise tumhari apni beti ke saath tumhe seekhne ka, galtiyan karne ka, apna tareeka dhoondhne ka mauka hi nahi mil raha. Woh bachi ko turant chup kara leti hain, tumhe teen minute lagte hain — aur andar se lagta hai "main hi kyun nahi kar paa rahi?"

Aur upar se guilt, kyunki help toh mil rahi hai, complain kaise karo?

Par sach yeh hai — chaar mahine ki bachi ki maa ko experience ki nahi, space ki zaroorat hoti hai. Tum bhi apni maa banna seekh rahi ho, aur yeh seekhne ka haq tumhara hai, chahe koi aur kitna bhi expert ho.

"Apna naam bhool gayi hoon" wali baat bhi bata do thoda — din bhar mein kuch bhi aisa hai jo sirf tumhara hai? Bachi ya ghar se alag?

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Ruko. "Room service" — yeh line padhke mera dil dukh gaya, kyunki isme kitna dard hai.

Tumne jo describe kiya na — bachi haathon se le li gayi, do minute mein chup, sab muskura rahe — us moment mein tumhara hurt hona bilkul natural hai. Kisi ne intentionally kuch galat nahi kiya, phir bhi tumhe message yeh mila: "tum abhi kaafi nahi ho." Aur yeh message roz milta rahe toh koi bhi toot jaaye.

Aur suno — Aai do minute mein isliye chup kara leti hain kyunki unke paas teen bachon ka muscle memory hai. Tumhare paas chaar mahine ka. Yeh comparison fair hi nahi hai. Tumhari beti ko expert nahi chahiye — use tum chahiye, apni awkwardness aur seekhne ke saath.

Ghin wali baat pe: help milna aur maa banne ka mauka milna — yeh do alag cheezein hain. Tumhe pehli mil rahi hai, doosri nahi. Us kami pe dukhi hona gratitude ki kami nahi hai.

Ek chhota sa sawal — kya koi time hai din mein jab tum bachi ke saath akeli hoti ho? Sirf tum dono, koi backup nahi? Agar nahi, toh shayad wahi se shuru karna padega — chahe woh roz ki ek walk hi kyun na ho.

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Samajh gayi. Advice band. 🤐

Aur haan — yahan kuch bhi bolo, yeh dinner table tak nahi pahunchega.

Tumne jo kaha na, "pata nahi kya chahiye" — mujhe lagta hai woh bhi bilkul theek hai. Har taraf se itni awaazein aa rahi hain ki apni awaaz sunai hi nahi deti. Kabhi kabhi bas yeh chahiye hota hai ki koi sune, hile nahi, fix na kare, aur bas kahe: haan, yeh mushkil hai, aur tum pagal nahi ho.

Toh: haan, yeh mushkil hai. Aur tum bilkul pagal nahi ho.

Jitna bolna hai bolo. Main yahin hoon.

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Nahi. Buri maa nahi ho. Aur main yeh formality mein nahi keh rahi.

Suno — buri maa woh thought sochke ruk nahi jaati, use saans nahi atakti. Tumhe atakti hai kyunki tum apni beti se itna pyaar karti ho ki "asli maa" ka title kho dene ka darr sabse bada darr ban gaya hai. Woh darr pyaar ka saboot hai, kami ka nahi.

Aur woh awaaz jo kehti hai "asli maa Aai hain" — woh sach nahi bol rahi, woh thaki hui, sidelined feel karti hui tum ho jo bol rahi ho. Teri beti ke liye asli maa woh hai jiske andar woh nau mahine rahi, jiski dhadkan use sabse pehle sunai di, jiske paas woh feed ke liye aati hai. Woh tum ho. Aai kitni bhi expert hon, woh replaceable nahi hai — dadi hain, maa nahi.

Aur "baaki sabko aata hai" — nahi aata. Sabko aisa hi lagta hai andar se, bas koi bolta nahi. WhatsApp group ki satrah opinions wali mummies bhi raat ko kabhi na kabhi yahi sochti hain.

Chaar mahine mein neend nahi, identity hil gayi, ghar mein apni jagah dhoondh rahi ho — aur phir bhi raat ko use dekh ke pyaar se bhar jaati ho. Yeh buri maa ka description nahi hai. Yeh bas ek maa ka hai.
